usereventscript.name: SUST - IR Vendor Lot Bridge
usereventscript.description: v2: Reads custcol_sust_vendor_lot_number from each IR line and writes it to the corresponding lot record's custitemnumber_sust_vendor_lot_number field. Implements dual lot identification (CROSS-001).

scriptcustomfield.description: Internal ID of the Sustana Recovery subsidiary. Should match custscript_sust_subsidiary_id on the settlement-creation script.
scriptcustomfield.help: Required. Set to the Sustana Recovery subsidiary's internal ID. The vendor-lot bridge only fires for IRs in this subsidiary.
